acts.desc: Ira talks to Eleanor Gordon-Smith, a writer/reporter in Australia who decides to confront her catcallers and figure out why they do it.
acts.label: Prologue
Act One
acts.desc:
The story from the prologue continues. Eleanor tries to persuade Zack and Mike not to catcall or
accost women in the streets of King’s Cross. She ends up having a long, open, and honest
conversation with Zack.
acts.title: Hollaback Girl

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Producer Stephanie Foo talks to veteran Michael Pitre, who had to change the way he talked about his experiences in the military after he realized the effect it was having on people. Michael is author of the novel " Fives and Twenty-Fives."
acts.title: The Real Decoy

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: A bomb disposal robot is assigned a new and even more complicated task. Fiction by Scott Brown, read by actor Jeremy Shamos.
acts.title: You Had One Job
